values.failure_policy: Fail closed without implementation, publication, merge, or closeout on an incomplete dependency gate, duplicate command authority, implicit network or selector behavior, invalid installation identity, non-atomic selector mutation, prior-state damage, unverified rollback, host-path or secret disclosure, forbidden dependency, unsupported LoC/module/test/time variance, deferred acceptance, stale review, red CI, or absent post-merge proof.
